_comment: Spoken narration for tour area A. Keys: area (area intro), outro (area scoreboard), a feature id (its title card), a step code (its caption). Placeholders: {COUNT} {PASSED} {FAILED}. Never speak ids, addresses, links or tokens. A step without a line is said as its title.
area: Area A is the notes app itself. These {COUNT} features cover writing a note, a setting an admin shares with everyone, and deleting a note.
outro: That is the notes area: {PASSED} of {COUNT} features passed.
A1: Creating a note. The list, the form and the note's own page have to work together.
A1.1: The editor opens the list of the team's notes.
A1.2: They write a new note: a title and a short body, then save it.
A1.3: The new note opens on its own page, exactly as it was written.
A1.4: Back on the list, a search finds the new note and nothing else.
A2: The workspace greeting. An admin's setting reaches everyone, so the tour puts it back afterwards.
A2.1: The admin opens the workspace settings.
A2.2: They save a new greeting. Before that, the tour wrote down the old one, so it can always be restored.
A2.3: The editor sees the new greeting at the top of the notes list.
A2.4: The tour puts the original greeting back, checks it, and the list shows it again.
A3: Deleting a note. This runs on development only, because a deleted note cannot come back.
A3.1: The editor opens a note they no longer need.
A3.2: Deleting it returns to the list, which confirms it and no longer shows the note.
